We move people and connect regions in the cantons of Valais, Uri and Graubünden and have been successfully setting accents in mobility and tourism for years. There are over 700 employees who live with a lot of heart blood and drive the values of our company and our brands. ## Mansioni As an entrepreneurial thinking and trusting manager, you take a key role as head: in finance & real estate, you shape the financial and property-related future of BVZ Holding - as a member of the management at eye level. ## Your field of action - You conduct Finance & Real Estate with the Departments Finance, Controlling and Real Estate and bear the overall responsibility for around 27 employees. - You are responsible for the group's services-oriented financial organization, including financial planning, financing, reporting and impact-oriented management processes, as well as group-wide insurance. - You conduct the real estate business area strategically and realize long-term real estate potentials along the route network. - You ensure compliance with the stock exchange obligations, in particular the accounting according to Swiss GAAP FER and the required publications and disclosure reports. - You develop your employees in a targeted manner and strengthen a performance-oriented, value-adding and modern leadership culture. - You actively shape processes, leverage digitization potentials and advance continuous improvements. ## Your profile You are convinced by expertise, strategic thinking and personal maturity: - You have a higher education in business administration (university or college) and/or a well-founded further education in finance (e.g. auditor:in, trust expert:in or expert:in in accounting & controlling). - You bring comprehensive management experience in finance and controlling and have sound real estate know-how (assessment, management, development, construction projects). - In-depth knowledge of public transport and the right to subsidisation are of great advantage. - You understand complex financial relationships, think strategically ahead and meet decisions with a vision. - High sense of responsibility, consequent target orientation and enforcement strength characterize you as well as the ability to advance issues even in resistance. - You are a close, mature and convincing leader with a safe appearance, high negotiation skills and clear argumentation. - In stakeholder management, you are confident, whether with customers, financial institutions, investors, board or partners. - Your German is stylistic and you have good language skills in English and French. ## Your advantages - A central, modern workplace in Brig and the possibility of mobile work. - A versatile and demanding task area with high design and responsibility at BVZ concert stage. -
